title: Total Cost of Studying in UK from Nepal 2027 — Complete Budget Guide
excerpt: The real, complete cost of studying in the UK from Nepal — tuition, visa, IHS, living costs, accommodation and flights in both GBP and NPR. No surprises.

The Real Cost — No Surprises, No Hidden Numbers

Most cost guides for studying in the UK only show tuition fees. The real picture includes the Nepal government's 3% education remittance tax, your TB test, NOC fee, education loan processing charges, IHS insurance payment, biometrics, and more — all of which must be paid before or alongside your visa application. Below are complete, itemized breakdowns for both a 1-Year Master's (PG) and a 3-Year Bachelor's (UG) — with every cost accounted for.

All conversions use 1 GBP = NPR 204. Exchange rates fluctuate — confirm the current rate before making transfers. All fees shown are approximate, not fixed — the tuition figure is a typical amount after scholarship, and your actual fee will depend on your university, course, and scholarship offer.

📌
About the CAS deposit Before your university issues your CAS, you pay a deposit — £4,000, or 50% or 70% of your first-year tuition, depending on the university. It is not an extra cost: the deposit is deducted from your tuition fee.

Postgraduate (PG) — 1-Year Master's Total Cost

A 1-year Master's is the most popular UK route for Nepali students. Here is every cost you will incur from Nepal — before, during, and after your visa application.

Why is the IHS calculated at 1.5 years on a 1-year Master's? Your Student visa is issued for the course duration plus about 4 months, so a 12-month Master's gets a visa of roughly 16 months — more than a full year. The IHS is charged at £776 per year, with a part-year of 6 months or less charged at half — so £776 × 1.5 = £1,164, paid upfront with your visa application.

Education Tax 3% — what is it? The Nepal government charges a 3% tax on foreign exchange remittances for education. When you transfer tuition fees to a UK university through a Nepali bank, this tax is levied on the amount remitted. For a £14,000 annual tuition, the tax is £420 (NPR 85,638) per year. Over 3 years of a UG degree, this totals £1,260 (NPR 2,57,040).

The 1-Year Master's is the most cost-efficient UK route for Nepali students At NPR 33.6 Lakhs in fixed costs before living expenses, a 1-year Master's delivers a globally recognized UK degree in 12 months, followed by 18 months of open work rights via the Graduate Route (for Graduate visa applications from January 1, 2027) — with no job offer required. The total investment is significantly lower than a 3-year bachelor's while delivering comparable career outcomes for most fields.

January 2027 Intake — Three Things That Affect Your Costs

  • Funds requirement rises on November 30, 2026: for applications from that date, maintenance funds go from £1,529 to £1,570 per month (London) and £1,171 to £1,203 (outside London) — about £369 and £288 more over 9 months. Applying before November 30 keeps the lower figure.
  • Graduate Route is 18 months for applications from January 1, 2027: a January 2027 starter on a 1-year Master's will graduate after that date, so plan for 18 months of post-study work rights, not 2 years.
  • Start your 28-day funds window in October: your statement must show the required balance for 28 consecutive days, ending within 31 days of your application — so a mid-November application means funds in place by mid-October.

Living Costs — What "Student's Own Choice" Typically Looks Like

Tickets, accommodation, shopping, and pocket money are listed as "student's own choice" because they vary widely by city, lifestyle, and personal preferences. Here are the typical ranges Nepali students should budget for:

  • Flight (Kathmandu to UK, one way): NPR 85,000 – 1,36,000. Book 2–3 months in advance for the best fares. Return tickets booked together are usually cheaper per leg.
  • Accommodation outside London (shared room/flat): NPR 91,800 – 1,42,800 per month (£450–£700). University halls in Year 1 are slightly higher but include bills and internet. Outside London is significantly cheaper than London.
  • Accommodation in London (shared room/flat): NPR 1,42,800 – 2,44,800 per month (£700–£1,200). University halls in London range from £800–£1,100/month.
  • Food and groceries: NPR 30,600 – 51,000 per month (£150–£250). Cooking at home from South Asian grocery stores (widely available in UK cities) reduces this significantly.
  • Transport: NPR 10,200 – 20,400 per month (£50–£100 outside London). London Oyster card costs more — budget NPR 20,400–40,800/month (£100–£200).
  • Personal / pocket money / shopping: NPR 16,320 – 40,800 per month (£80–£200). Highly personal — varies by student.

Part-time work offset: Working 20 hours per week at the UK minimum wage of £12.21/hour earns approximately £880–£950 per month (NPR 1,79,520–1,93,800) during term time. During university holidays (Christmas, Easter, Summer), you can work full-time — a 10-week summer gives you approximately £4,884 gross (NPR ~9.96 Lakhs).

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the Education Tax (3%) when sending money to UK for studies?
The Nepal government charges a 3% tax on foreign exchange remittances sent abroad for education. When you transfer your tuition fee through a Nepali bank, this tax is deducted at source. For a £14,000 annual tuition, the tax is £420 (approximately NPR 85,638). This applies each year tuition is remitted — so UG students pay it 3 times and PG students pay it once.
Is the IHS (Insurance Payment) paid every year or once?
The IHS is paid as a single lump sum upfront at the time of your visa application — covering the entire duration of your visa. For a 1-year Master's (visa of about 16 months, charged as 1.5 years), you pay £1,164 once (NPR 2,37,339). For a 3-year Bachelor's (visa of about 40 months, charged as 3.5 years), you pay £2,716 once (NPR 5,54,064). You do not pay it again each year — just once before your visa is granted.
How much money do I need to show in my bank account for the UK visa?
You must show your remaining first-year tuition fees (after your CAS deposit) plus living cost evidence — £10,539 (NPR ~21.5 Lakhs) if studying outside London, or £13,761 (NPR ~28.1 Lakhs) if studying in London. For applications from November 30, 2026 these rise to £10,827 (NPR ~22.1 Lakhs) and £14,130 (NPR ~28.8 Lakhs). These funds must be held for 28 consecutive days before your application date. An education loan sanctioned letter from your bank is accepted in place of personal savings.
Is a 1-year Master's or a 3-year Bachelor's better value from Nepal?
For most Nepali students, the 1-year Master's is significantly better value. Fixed costs are NPR 33.6 Lakhs compared to NPR 95.6 Lakhs for a 3-year bachelor's — and living costs are one third as long. The UK's Graduate Route then provides 18 months of open work rights after your Master's (for applications from January 1, 2027), making the total time in the UK roughly 2.5 years for a fraction of the cost. For students completing a bachelor's in Nepal first and then pursuing a UK Master's, this is by far the most cost-efficient pathway.
